[comment by embeddedt (owner)]
I don't think this error should cause the server to crash by itself, but if it does, disable `mixin.perf.clear_mixin_classinfo` (it's not enabled by default, anyways). The error is caused by another mod applying mixins on the server that are only designed for the client.
